# Which labels are inflating your metrics bill?

> Paste a Prometheus or OpenMetrics /metrics scrape and see active series per metric, the high-cardinality labels, the exact series saved by dropping each one, and a monthly cost estimate on Grafana Cloud or Datadog-style pricing. Free, runs in your browser, nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.

## Pages

- [Why Prometheus metrics bills explode, and which labels to drop](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/prometheus-cardinality-cost/why-prometheus-metrics-bills-explode-and-which-labels-to-drop.html)
